names: Montanic acid esters, Montan acid esters

more_info.overview: Montanic acid esters are preparations containing montan acids and their esters with ethylene glycol, 1,3-butanediol or glycerol. It forms a surface coating that gives the food a shiny appearance or provides a protective finish. The specified material is supplied as white powder or granules.
more_info.banned_in:
Banned in: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden.
The EU removed montan acid esters from the authorised food-additive list in 2014 after the required safety information was not provided; foods previously lawfully marketed could be sold until stocks were exhausted.
